title: Time consuming and impractical
text: Time consuming and impractical. Another kitchen gadget to add to my cluttered utensil collection.  It’s difficult to use, and it’s use is limited.  How many times do you need to, or have the time to make fancy spirals?  It has 1 specific function, and I appreciate kitchen tools to be multi-functional.
